# Kashtrix AI-Native Telecom OSS/BSS Platform

> Kashtrix is a unified, AI-native OSS/BSS, FreeRADIUS AAA, and Carrier-Grade Syslog CGNAT compliance platform designed for ISPs, WISPs, FTTH operators, and telecom providers.

## Core Capabilities
- **BSS Core**: Subscriber Billing, CRM, Prepaid/Postpaid Plans, Automated Dunning, Multi-Tenant Reseller Accounting.
- **OSS Core**: FreeRADIUS AAA, GPON OLT Provisioning (Huawei, ZTE, FiberHome, V-SOL), BNG Routing, TR-069 ACS Server, Fiber GIS Mapping.
- **Carrier Syslog & CGNAT**: 100,000+ EPS Log Collector, Subsecond Subpoena Query Engine, SHA-256 HMAC Tamper-Proof Archiving.
- **AI NOC & Agents**: Autonomous AI Employees for Ticket Isolation, Device Command Generation, Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server.
